label: ctas-history
sql:
CREATE TABLE mvela_fleet.fleet_history
WITH (
  format            = 'PARQUET',
  write_compression = 'SNAPPY',
  external_location = 's3://mvela-fleet-lake-<account-id>-us-east-1/curated/fleet_history/',
  partitioned_by    = ARRAY['dt']
) AS
SELECT truck_id, depot, event_ms, lat, lon, speed_kmh, heading, engine_on, fuel_pct,
       driver_id, driver_phone,
       date_format(from_unixtime(event_ms / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d') AS dt
FROM mvela_fleet.raw_pings_json
